goal:
Build the TOILET token contract: a capped-supply NEP-141 whose supply can only be issued by a configured emitter, with a venue tax that mirrors mPOO's on-chain shape.

WHY
TOILET is the game's earning and staking asset (docs/economy/2026-10-28-toilet-economy-v1.md). It needs its own contract: NEP-141 so it can trade, issued only by the game, hard-capped at 1,000,000,000 x 10^18, and able to burn in two places - a venue tax and a staking-vault exit tax (the vault is a separate contract and out of scope here).

IMPORTANT DESIGN NOTE
The brief says 'fixed supply, no mint'. With longevity issuance those two are incompatible: a hard cap plus issuance requires a mint that is capped and role-gated. The honest version implemented here is: no admin mint, one `emitter` account that can mint only up to CAP, and `issued_total` tracked so the cap can never be re-opened by a burn.

SCOPE
- NEP-141: ft_transfer, ft_transfer_call, ft_balance_of, ft_total_supply, ft_metadata (18 decimals, symbol TOILET). NEP-145 minimal storage: storage_deposit, storage_withdraw, storage_balance_of, storage_balance_bounds. 1 yoctoNEAR required on transfers.
- Supply: CAP = 1_000_000_000 * 10^18. `mint(account, amount)` callable only by `emitter`, rejected if issued_total + amount > CAP. `burn(amount)` burns the caller's own balance. Track total_supply, issued_total, burned_total separately.
- Venue tax, mirroring mPOO's `get_tax` shape: {buy_bps, sell_bps, exchange: AccountId, treasury: AccountId, burn_bps, treasury_bps, exempt: Vec<AccountId>}. Applied only when the counterparty of the transfer is the configured exchange (buy = exchange sends, sell = exchange receives), never on wallet-to-wallet. Tax is taken in TOILET: burn_bps share is burned (supply falls), treasury_bps share is transferred to the treasury account.
- Owner controls: set_emitter, set_tax (with a price-style cooldown is NOT required here, but the tax must emit a `tax_changed` event), pause transfers independent of minting.
- Burn-page views: get_supply_info() -> {cap, total_supply, issued_total, burned_total, tax_burned_total, tax_treasury_total, remaining_issuable}, get_tax(), get_emitter().

CONSTRAINTS
- New crate contracts/toilet. Do not touch contracts/paid-board or contracts/board.
- No staking, no vault, no reward accumulator in this task.
- Integer math only; checked arithmetic everywhere amounts are added or divided for a tax share. Round tax down and never let a rounding error mint value.

ACCEPTANCE
- Test: mint by a non-emitter panics; mint that would exceed CAP panics; issued_total never decreases on burn, so a post-burn mint cannot exceed the cap.
- Test: a transfer where neither side is the exchange is untaxed; a buy and a sell each take the configured split; an exempt account pays nothing.
- Test: the tax split sums exactly to the tax taken (no dust escapes).
- Test: storage_deposit/withdraw behave per NEP-145 for one account.
- get_supply_info reports cap, issued, burned and remaining consistently after a mint, a burn and a taxed trade.

DO NOT
- Do not deploy. This task ends at code plus tests plus a README section describing the tax semantics and the fee-on-transfer risk to standard AMM pools (a pool may mis-account a transfer that delivers less than `amount`; see the economy doc section 14).
- Do not add holder payouts; mPOO already has that through NEARLY and TOILET must not duplicate a claim stack.
